I am writing this review to share my recent experience at Mersea Island Practice, hoping it will help the community and other families.

During my visit, I encountered significant issues while trying to assist my wife, who was in severe pain. Over 13 days, we experienced a lack of modern practices and poor communication from some team members. One staff member, in particular, was very rude and unaccommodating, which added to our stress during an already difficult time.

Key points of concern:

Rudeness and Lack of Professionalism: The attitude of some staff members was unprofessional and frustrating. It is unacceptable for patients and their families to bear the brunt of staff dissatisfaction.

Communication Issues: Effective communication is crucial in healthcare. Unfortunately, this was lacking, and it significantly impacted our experience.

Outdated Practices: The practice does not seem to align with 21st-century standards. For instance, there is no email address available for referrals or documentation, and the appointment booking process is inefficient.

Appointment System: The current system requires patients to queue at 8 AM to secure an appointment. This method is not only outdated but also impractical for many patients, especially those in pain.

Lack of Empathy: After 13 days of continuous pain, the lack of care and urgency from the practice was disappointing. It felt as though they did not genuinely care about the well-being of their patients.

Overall, the practice needs significant improvements to meet modern healthcare standards and provide better service to its patients. Listening to patient feedback and implementing changes is essential for progress.
